end.summary:
Observed bird and plant features using a balcony scene.
Described a pigeon’s small, slightly pointy beak and seed-eating.
Identified beak shape as an observation feature.
Later described a bird with a long, pointed beak and webbed feet for catching fish and swimming.
Teach-back was not passed; one unaided correct attempt was not recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing and describing beaks and feet with Atharv. They used a balcony scene to talk about plants, birds, a pigeon’s beak, and how webbed feet help a bird swim. Atharv first gave a short description, then later added clearer details about a long, pointed beak and webbed feet; the earlier mix-up was corrected after it was seen again. At home, look at one bird or plant together and name two visible features and what each may help it do.
